case_title: Yogarani v. State by The Inspector of Police
statutory_provisions: IPC s.420, Passports Act s.12(1)(b), s.12(2); Prevention of Corruption Act s.13(1)(d), s.13(2)
trial_court_outcome: Convicted of offences punishable under IPC s.420 and Passports Act s.12(1)(b) and s.12(2)
neutral_facts: The prosecution alleged that the appellant facilitated the issuance of a second passport for accused No.1, who was already holding an Indian passport. Accused No.1 had deposited his passport with his employer in Dubai and applied for a second passport to secure better employment opportunities. The application was routed through the appellant and other accused persons. The second passport was returned undelivered to the Passport Office in Trichy and later delivered to the appellant by accused No.3, who was in charge of safe custody of passports. The prosecution claimed that the appellant demanded payment of Rs.5,000/- from accused No.1, which was refused, leading to the return of the second passport to the Passport Office by registered post. The evidence included testimonies from three witnesses, but the prosecution failed to establish that the appellant had prior knowledge of accused No.1's existing passport or knowingly furnished false information.
